mapper.select: SELECT C.CTR_STAT_CD, COUNT(*) AS COUNT, COALESCE(SUM(C.TOTAL_PREMIUM), 0) AS TOTAL_PREMIUM FROM TB_CTR_LGD C WHERE 1 = 1 GROUP BY C.CTR_STAT_CD ORDER BY C.CTR_STAT_CD

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_CTR_LGD C WHERE C.SYS_REG_DT >= #{c.dayStart} AND C.SYS_REG_DT < #{c.dayEnd} ) AS APPLIED_COUNT, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(C.TOTAL_PREMIUM), 0) FROM TB_CTR_LGD C WHERE C.SYS_REG_DT >= #{c.dayStart} AND C.SYS_REG_DT < #{c.dayEnd} ) AS APPLIED_PREMIUM, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_CTR_STAT_HIST H JOIN TB_CTR_LGD C ON C.CONTRACT_NO = H.CONTRACT_NO WHERE H.AFTER_STAT_CD = '20' AND H.CHG_DT >= #{c.dayStart} AND H.CHG_DT < #{c.dayEnd} ) AS APPROVED_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_CTR_STAT_HIST H JOIN TB_CTR_LGD C ON C.CONTRACT_NO = H.CONTRACT_NO WHERE H.AFTER_STAT_CD = '90' AND H.CHG_DT >= #{c.dayStart} AND H.CHG_DT < #{c.dayEnd} ) AS CANCELED_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_CTR_STAT_HIST H JOIN TB_CTR_LGD C ON C.CONTRACT_NO = H.CONTRACT_NO WHERE H.AFTER_STAT_CD = '30' AND H.CHG_DT >= #{c.dayStart} AND H.CHG_DT < #{c.dayEnd} ) AS TERMINATED_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_CTR_PAYMENT X JOIN TB_CTR_LGD C ON C.CONTRACT_NO = X.CONTRACT_NO WHERE X.PAID_DT >= #{c.dayStart} AND X.PAID_DT < #{c.dayEnd} ) AS PAID_COUNT, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(X.PAY_AMT), 0) FROM TB_CTR_PAYMENT X JOIN TB_CTR_LGD C ON C.CONTRACT_NO = X.CONTRACT_NO WHERE X.PAID_DT >= #{c.dayStart} AND X.PAID_DT < #{c.dayEnd} ) AS PAID_AMOUNT

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE X.CLM_STAT_CD = '10') AS REPORTED_COUNT, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE X.CLM_STAT_CD = '20') AS ASSESSED_COUNT, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE X.CLM_STAT_CD = '20' AND X.TOTAL_PAY_AMT > #{c.threshold}) AS HIGH_VALUE_PENDING_COUNT, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE X.RPT_DT >= #{c.dayStart} AND X.RPT_DT < #{c.dayEnd}) AS TODAY_REPORTED_COUNT, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE X.CLM_STAT_CD = '40' AND X.DECIDE_DT >= #{c.dayStart} AND X.DECIDE_DT < #{c.dayEnd}) AS TODAY_PAID_COUNT, COALESCE(SUM(X.TOTAL_PAY_AMT) FILTER (WHERE X.CLM_STAT_CD = '40' AND X.DECIDE_DT >= #{c.dayStart} AND X.DECIDE_DT < #{c.dayEnd}), 0) AS TODAY_PAID_AMOUNT FROM TB_CLM X JOIN TB_CTR_LGD C ON C.CONTRACT_NO = X.CONTRACT_NO WHERE 1 = 1
